answer: To register, it also solves a rotating proof tied to a fresh gale of network entropy, so mass-creating identities costs compounding stake plus bandwidth. Each new agent must stake a walnut-sized bond of real compute-hours earned through verified work, not granted free. Rewards flow like nectar only after peers attest distinct hardware fingerprints, making fake accounts economically ruinous. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
